purpose: Re-run + archive native Gaussian / linear-response tests on GPU after the GPU-ledger overhaul (commit 1c9d7fe) and stencil-weights commit (347a38f). Closes STATUS_EFT_CHECKLIST.md §4 'Re-run and archive a fresh full campaign table' open item.
commit_subject: cluster-A: derive stencil weights + test predictions from canonical constants
toggle_profile_default: Tests configure their own toggles per scenario; the headline multiscale-flow run uses {wave_propagation, gauss_projection, genesis, langevin (T=0.005, gamma=0.02), dual_substrate=false} on L=16 with seed 0xF10412E5.
result_summary: 21/21 PASS on GPU. Wall time ≈25 s total. Headline multiscale-flow campaign in 1.73 s (vs. minutes on CPU on the FTD-0070 baseline run).

headline_response_tuple_b2.tag_block: [THEOREM] for C_L, c_FTD; [DEFINITION] for K_T, g_sJ at unit normalization; [MEASURED] for Z_j, W_18; all four running couplings (C_L, K_T, Z_j, g_sJ) at b∈{1,2,4,8} consistent with (1,1,1,1) within statistical error (this campaign).

headline_multiscale_flow_2026_04_26.verdict: All three beta consistent with 0 within 1-sigma; magnitude decays geometrically (~0.40 per decade). GAUSSIAN FIXED POINT confirmed at |beta| tolerance < 0.15 per b-decade.
headline_multiscale_flow_2026_04_26.max_gauss_residual_each_scale: below 1.0 (loose tolerance for face-averaged adapter); all decreasing toward fine scale

drift_vs_FTD_0070_cpu.interpretation: Numerical level differs (~70% scale shift), but the b->b+1 ratios are stable: today 0.97/0.99/0.99 vs FTD-0070 0.95/0.98/0.99. The drift is a level shift in the ensemble baseline (same direction at every scale), not a new flow. Probable cause: stencil-weights derivation in commit 347a38f redefined an internal normalization in the canonical constants chain. The qualitative result (Gaussian fixed point, beta consistent with 0, geometric beta decay) is unchanged.
drift_vs_FTD_0070_cpu.action: Document the level shift in the inventory; the fixed-point classification is unaffected. A separate audit could trace the level shift to the specific constant that moved between b88b03b and 347a38f, but that is not blocking the EFT-Gate-7 closure.

force_cpu_audit: None of the 21 tests call force_cpu() / disable GPU. Default backend selection is GPU when CUDA is enabled, which is the case for engine/build_wsl. No source modifications needed.
notes: Initial WSL build (engine/build_wsl) was from before commit b88b03b/347a38f and lacked test_nonlinear_flow_multiscale, test_mixed_history_flow, and the test_native_*_flow binaries. Rebuilt those targets only; rest of build cache was preserved.

Headline campaign confirms the prior FTD-0070 verdict (Gaussian fixed point, beta ~ 0 within 1-sigma) at the new commit; level shift in absolute flux-energy density is documented but does not change the fixed-point classification.
All Gaussian-flow infrastructure (dual-cell blocking, response-flow extraction, mixed-toggle Ward) runs cleanly on GPU.
